sst_gradient.distance_metric: Geodesic metric with latitude-dependent dx = R_E * cos(lat) * dlon * pi/180
sst_gradient.caveat: Gradient alone is an edge indicator; confirmed thermal fronts require spatial edge continuity and bimodal histogram checks.

wind_stress.qa_precondition: CFSv2 artifact masking (wind speed must be < 30 m/s and isolated spikes rejected)

ekman_dynamics.southern_hemisphere_sign: f = 2 * Omega * sin(lat) is NEGATIVE. Ekman transport deflects 90 deg LEFT of wind.
ekman_dynamics.upwelling_sign: w_E > 0 denotes upward velocity (upwelling); w_E < 0 denotes downwelling.

current_and_eke.vertical_level: Surface layer (HYCOM z=0m; CMEMS ANFC z=0.494m)
current_and_eke.resolution_caveat: Coarse 1/12 deg model captures mesoscale features (>50 km), not submesoscale coastal eddies.

bathymetry_and_shelf.datum: Mean Sea Level (MSL), depths positive downwards (D = -z)
bathymetry_and_shelf.classification_policy: Neritic (D <= 200m) vs Oceanic (D > 200m). Slope magnitude is reported as an auxiliary terrain variable, NOT sole classifier.
